challengeTypes: identify: How many pieces are in a TANGRAM puzzle? (7 pieces — 5 triangles, 1 square, 1 parallelogram vs 5 pieces vs 10 pieces)

extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Tangram — 7 pieces: 2 large triangles, 1 medium triangle, 2 small triangles, 1 square, 1 parallelogram. Pieces fit together to form a square. Can be rearranged to make animals, people, shapes. Composing (joining) and decomposing (breaking apart) shapes. (2) Tessellation — covering a surface with repeated shapes that fit together with no gaps and no overlaps. Squares, rectangles, and hexagons tessellate. Circles do NOT tessellate (they leave gaps). (3) Circle — centre is the middle point. Radius is the distance from centre to any point on the circle. Diameter is the distance across the circle through the centre. All radii of a circle are equal. Diameter = 2 x radius. Radius = diameter / 2. (4) Reflection symmetry — one half is a mirror image of the other. The fold line is the line of symmetry. Butterfly, leaf, human face, letter A are symmetric. Square has 4 lines, rectangle has 2, equilateral triangle has 3, circle has infinite, scalene triangle has 0. (5) Area and perimeter — area is the space inside a shape. Square area = side x side. Rectangle area = length x breadth. Triangle area = 1/2 x base x height. Perimeter is the distance around the edge. Square perimeter = 4 x side. Rectangle perimeter = 2 x (length + breadth). (6) Plan, elevation, side view — plan view: looking from directly above (top view). Elevation view: looking from the front (front view). Side view: looking from the side. Misconceptions: 'radius and diameter are the same' (diameter is TWICE the radius — d = 2r, r = d/2), 'all shapes can tessellate' (circles leave gaps — only shapes that fit without gaps tessellate, like squares, rectangles, triangles, hexagons), 'a rectangle has 4 lines of symmetry' (a rectangle has only 2 lines of symmetry — horizontal and vertical, NOT diagonal), 'area and perimeter are the same' (area measures the SPACE INSIDE, perimeter measures the DISTANCE AROUND — they are different measurements), 'plan view means looking from the front' (plan view is looking from ABOVE — elevation is looking from the front). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function ShapesSymmetryGame), NOT export default. Export interface ShapesSymmetryGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void. Use double quotes for ALL strings containing apostrophes. Use 'currentChallenge' as variable name, NOT 'challenge'. Auto-hint timer MUST be exactly 10000ms.
